domain_rule.inputs: Union of calibration native-float32 and exact-float64 operator inputs; later calibration-only revisions may also include prior calibration approximate trajectories.
domain_rule.degenerate_or_nonfinite: preserve failure; do not clip or silently create a domain

analytic_selection.inverse_fallback: Fixed Newton count from public interval; reject unsupported/nonfinite planning

silu_fallback.reciprocal_count: fixed from public domain and residual target

analytic_selection.target_scope: Local analytic-function grid targets; not uniform polynomial error certificates or model/HE guarantees. Newton interval residual bounds are recorded separately.

softmax.count_selection: Smallest count meeting1e-12 directed/exact residual bound for actual rounded initial affine, before activations
softmax.K1: Public causal singleton probability1, while manifest still supplies its explicit entry
softmax.arithmetic: Preserve existing Qwen public C1 reciprocal and normalized-squaring graph for this repair experiment; no silent C32/HE optimization mix.

sequence: Freeze corpus, protocol, tokenizer outputs, pins and source archive before any calibration model evaluation.
Run native and independent exact calibration trajectories; preserve semantic checks, all ranges and original-model greedy calibration tokens.
Select candidate only from calibration input ranges and fixed analytic targets. Freeze manifest hash before approximate outputs.
Run complete approximate calibration prefill plus teacher-forced and free-running calibration decode; record all operator/block/logit errors and every propagated domain failure without clipping.

If calibration fails, preserve that manifest and result. Up to3 total calibration-only candidate revisions may use the same predeclared range rule and analytic targets on calibration trajectories; never inspect held-out metrics or use output errors to fit coefficients.
Freeze the first calibration-passing candidate before opening validation. Re-run the exact frozen48+8 validation workload, preserving all original gates and every failure.

Once validation is measured, do not feed its ranges/logits/token choices into candidate selection. Any subsequent design is separately labeled as informed by this validation and needs a new untouched validation set.

gates.HE_gates: Untested and not inferred; original HE-versus-approximate0.01 nRMSE/0.10 maxabs remain separate.

claims_excluded: Learning coefficients from validation logits, extrema or generated tokens
